NEW 2026 Summer Camp Alert: Math + VEX Robotics

SUMMER Camps 2026

Turn Your School Break into an Exciting STEM Journey!
Register Now

New for 2026

The Robo Hub is turning up creativity this summer with all-new programs powered by some of the biggest names in STEM: Our collaborations with Vex and MIT create an environment for kids to invent, learn, and collaborate in ways that feel like play. These camps are hands-on, minds-on, and all–fun.

Math and Vex Robotics!

We are excited to announce the launch of a brand-new, EXCLUSIVE summer camp workshop at The Robo Hub. This exclusive Math & VEX Robotics Camp will run for only five weeks this summer, offering students a unique opportunity to explore how mathematics directly powers robotics, engineering, and real-world problem solving.

In this innovative program, students will learn how math concepts apply to robot design, movement, programming, and competition strategy through hands-on VEX robotics projects. The goal is to help students see mathematics not just as theory, but as a powerful tool engineers and innovators use every day.

What makes this program truly special is the exceptional team of educators and experts leading the workshop

 

Register Now

MIT App Inventor

This summer, kids can build their own apps using the groundbreaking MIT App Inventor platform. Younger campers (grades 3–5) will dive into creative coding challenges like StoryGPT, mixing imagination with AI magic. Older campers explore advanced projects straight from MIT’s library—coding real apps for Android and iPhone. By week’s end, they’ll walk away with a working app and the confidence that comes from bringing an idea to life.

 

Register Now

Returning Favorites — Leveled Up for 2026

Our fan favorites are back—rebuilt, recharged, and ready for a new summer of invention. Campers build on last year’s skills with fresh projects and deeper challenges.

Battling Robots

The arena returns! Builders from last summer come back ready to level up—experimenting with new drive systems, smarter code, and upgraded armor. New campers learn the fundamentals of robotics and friendly competition; returning ones up their game, fine-tuning bots designed to win. 

Drones & Rockets
Back and soaring higher than ever, this camp sends curiosity skyward. Campers explore flight through drones, rockets, and hands-on experiments that make physics come alive. Returning and new pilots tackle design challenges—building faster rockets and bet
Electricity
It’s full charge ahead for young inventors! Circuits Camp lights up imagination through glowing art, buzzing gadgets, and digital experiments. Campers learn how electricity powers their world and how to build, test, and troubleshoot electronic creations. Returning engineers level up with sensors, motors, and interactivity that make their projects spark to life.
Tech & STEAM
Our youngest creators return to build, code, and imagine in the signature Tech & STEAM series—Tech Explorers, Tech Crafters, and Stories & STEAM. Kids mix art, science, and engineering through screen-free, hands-on activities designed for growth. Each session adds new puzzles, design challenges, and reasons to ask, “what if?”

Summer programs are based on the rising grade level.

For example, a child going into grade 4 in September is eligible for a Summer camp for 4th graders.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do grade levels work?

Summer programs are based on the rising grade level. For example, a child going into grade 4 in September is eligible for a Summer camp for 4th graders.

What is the daily schedule like?
A typical day might look something like this. Please note that this is a sample schedule and times may shift, extend, or adapt based on the needs of the specific program and group. 

  • 9:00: Drop Off
  • 9:30: Morning Meeting
  • 10:00 STEM Block*
  • 10:30 Snack
  • 10:45 STEM Block*
  • 11:30 Outdoor Time
  • 12:30 Lunch
  • 1:00 STEM Block*
  • 3:00 Afternoon Meeting
  • 3:30 Pack Up for Pick Up
  • *STEM blocks contain content specific to the camp your child is enrolled in. 
What is the camper-to-staff ratio?
The Massachusetts Department of Public Health requires that we maintain a ratio of at least 1:10 Teachers to Students. The Robo Hub aims to exceed this minimum in order to provide more individualized support to each camper. 
What is your cancellation and refund policy?
We know plans can change, and we try to make things as flexible as possible while keeping camp running smoothly for everyone. Here’s how it works:

For Summer Camp:

  • Before 2/1/2026 → Full refund or full credit.
  • 2/1/2026 to 4/30/2026 → Camp credit only (no refund).
  • 5/1/2026  and after → No refund or credit, but you can switch to another session, if available.
  • Email requests to info@therobohub.com

For Vacation Camps:

  • Cancel 30 days before your camp starts → Full refund or full credit.
  • Cancel within 30 days → No refund or credit, but we’ll do our best to move you to another session if space allows.

All cancellations must be sent in writing to info@therobohub.com.

Are the camps suitable for beginners?
Yes! We design our camp curriculum to be suitable for both beginners of any age, and more advanced, experienced campers looking for a challenge.
How will I receive updates about the camp?
We’ll be in touch with you throughout the week with updates from your child’s group. We’ll also reach out to you directly with any urgent needs or updates about your child at camp, and we’ll send out a weekly survey at the end of the week to help improve our programs over the course of the summer. If there’s anything else you need, reach out to your Camp Director directly, or email info@therobohub.com, and a member of our team will direct your inquiry to the right person!
What is the registration deadline?
We close registration the Thursday before the start date of each program. However, if additional paperwork or accommodations are required, we ask that those are submitted with registration at least a week before your child’s program begins.
Is program tuition eligible for Flexible Spending Account (FSA) reimbursement?

Yes, our Camp and After-school care programs are eligible for FSA! You can get a receipt with our EIN by logging into your Sawyer account and looking up your order, and printing the receipt.
